title: SF719 (2025-2026 Regular): Constitutional amendment proposal to add a section to Article I protecting the right of people to keep and bear arms

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-01-24; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/SF/719/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2025-01-24. Constitutional amendment proposal, submitted to voters at the 2026 general election; identical to SF 842 (2023) except the election year.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Const. art. I, new sec. 18): A well regulated militia, being necessary to the security of a free state, the right of the people to keep and bear arms, shall not be infringed.
Section 2 (ballot question): "Shall the Minnesota Constitution be amended to protect the right of the people to keep and bear arms?
